senses.gloss:
गुध् cl. 4. P. ˚ध्यति (ind.p. गुधित्वा, Pāṇ. i, 2, 7; see उप-गुध),
to wrap up, envelop, cover, clothe (cf. √ गुण्ठ्), Dhātup. xxvi, 13 : cl. 9. P. ˚ध्नाति, to be angry, xxxi, 45: cl. 1. Ā. गोधते, to play, sport (cf. √ गूर्द्, गुद्), ii, 23;
गुध् [cf. Gk. κεύθω; Old Germ. hūt; Germ. haut; Angl.Sax. hyde, hyd; Lat. cutis ?]
